description: Manually trigger a flow run for testing. Starts at the 'trigger.manual' node if present, otherwise the first trigger node. Optionally provide a payload object that becomes {{trigger.*}} in the flow.

id.description: UUID of the flow to run.

nodeId.description: Specific trigger node id to start from (for flows with multiple triggers).

payload.description: Test payload available as {{trigger.*}} in the flow — e.g. { text: 'hello', contactPhone: '2348012345678', senderName: 'Test User' }.

name: neuron_run_flow
title: Run Flow
